scope: Fresh bounded FIRST N98 bilingual offline choice review only. No whole-card, held-figure, native, render, production, source, integration or publication approval.
review_identity: One independent reviewing Codex agent, distinct from the author; two separately inspected locale snapshots. No delegation or chat operations.
review_order: Read the choice SKILL, review.md, contract.md and production-resume instructions.
Read the tool seed and only the literal approved supplementary prose indices; open zero image assets.
Freeze eight source records before opening either author draft: seven complete solutions and one explicit bounded partial length solution.
Read the zh and en draft view projections, then freeze every visible option judgment and the complete resolvable sets before opening author intent or keys.
Compare author intent, limitations, coverage, keys and rationales only after both freezes. Do not open the separate author source-solutions-FIRST.json or any external answer-key file.
Write separate strict-contract zh/review.json and en/review.json with the unresolved length gate blocked, not guessed.
Run validate.py with the respective review exactly once per locale. Both mechanical checks pass and both return exit 3 for the declared blocked semantic outcome.
Confirm seed/draft hashes and six supplementary file/selection bindings remain unchanged; retain evidence and validation receipts inside the exclusive root.

hold.reason: The permitted N97 text supplies qualitative longitudinal contraction and simultaneous endpoint measurement but references equation (8.2) without stating it. An exact law was not independently established in the pre-key source/option freezes. a, c and d all meet those qualitative bounds; b alone is independently disproved. After the freeze the author selected a and introduced a Lorentz-coordinate premise not in the approved excerpt or frozen independent derivation. That later author premise cannot supply the required prior independent evidence.
not_claimed: That option a or the author's actual length formula is mathematically false.
That a missing image prevents this text-only task.
That N94/N97 passed text is on HOLD because of separate held figures.
That a physically correct remembered formula or later author key may substitute for the requested frozen independent solution.
That 8/8 source mapping constitutes 8/8 approved quantitative coverage.

input_bindings.canonical_convention: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True, separators=(comma, colon)); actual seed/draft canonical bindings accepted by validate.py.
input_bindings.supplementary_selection_convention: Literal zero-based prose indices. Selection hashes bind an ordered list of {block,kind,text}, with text only from the modern paragraph text field; historical source_text and author metadata are not solution authority.
input_bindings.supplementary_binding_digest_convention: Canonical digest of the ordered six-entry list projected to {path,file_sha256,selection_sha256}. Individual block lists and hashes of their exact text selections are also preserved in the pre-draft freeze.

all_truth_checks.applies_to: Both separately inspected zh and en views; corresponding option meanings and conditions are equivalent.
all_truth_checks.formal_blocked_representation: Each contract review uses correct=null and option_checks=[] for the blocked length question. Its independent_solution explicitly examines all four options, including the false b. The pre-key view freeze retains structured judgments for all four. Neither omission from formal option_checks nor U is counted as a passing truth check.
all_truth_checks.author_comparison: All 31 independently determined truths per locale agree with later author rationales. Seven complete sets per locale agree with the author. The author's length set [a] is not independently certified, and its remaining three exact-law truths are not inferred from the key.
